purpose: Rename the browser package from @felipegalind0/jsbsim-wasm to @felipegalind0/jsbsim. The old name described a separate SDK source that no longer exists after the in-tree consolidation.

buildReproducibility.finding: Rebuilding the same commit with the same toolchain on the same machine produced a different WASM binary.
buildReproducibility.likelyCandidate: parallel optimisation-pass ordering in native codegen/link
buildReproducibility.consequence: A shipped binary cannot be re-derived from its source revision. The tarball is the authority, not the commit. A hash difference between two builds of one revision is not evidence of a source or behaviour change.
buildReproducibility.adoptedArtifact: The first build, packed and hash-locked; the second was discarded and the accepted pointers were restored and re-verified.

appChanges: 56 import specifiers across 41 files in src/, scripts/ and vite.config.ts.
jsbsimBuildIdentity.ts now pairs every accepted version with the exact name it was published under and exports expectedJsbsimPackageName plus JSBSIM_ACCEPTED_PACKAGE_NAMES.
verify-jsbsim-artifact.mjs resolves the declared package name from that accepted set instead of a single constant, and requires exactly one declared JSBSim dependency.
docs/jsbsim-wasm.md renamed to docs/jsbsim.md with all inbound links retargeted.
gateStrengthChange: The identity gate is strictly stronger: it now also rejects a renamed package claiming a pre-rename version, and the verifier rejects more than one declared JSBSim dependency.
preservedDeliberately: 0x62/jsbsim-wasm MIT notice and Benedict Lewis's copyright in wasm/LICENSE and the packed notices.
The upstream 0x62 demo link and open SDK PR #8 references.
The retired standalone checkout path under /Users/felg/gh/.preservation/.../retired-jsbsim-wasm, which is a real path on disk.
Dated validation records and the fork.1-fork.4 tarball filenames, which are identified by name plus SHA-256 and were not rewritten.

fullAppSuite.note: All 16 failures are pre-existing and unrelated to the rename. 10 are in createFlightSimApp.phone.test.ts, whose committed vi.mock of aircraftCatalog predates the normalizeAircraftSelection export added by the user's uncommitted aircraft-family work. 6 are in preserved foss-earth recovery copies under build/validation/ that vitest globs. Neither references the package.

nativeWasmParity.note: Identical to the fork.3 and fork.4 results, which is the available behavioural evidence that the rename changed nothing, given the binary is not reproducible.

rollback.note: fork.1 through fork.4 keep the pre-rename package name, so rolling back to one requires restoring that release's declaration, lock and jsbsimBuildIdentity.ts together.

notDone: The turbine trim fuel-flow fix (7511df10) is deliberately not in this package; it is a separate adoption cycle.
No hosted CI run is claimed for this revision.
No aircraft calibration, AFM fit or terrain claim is made.
